summary: All 7 targeted features verified. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (proof gallery CRUD + video-in-list + video byte serve + Stripe pro checkout create/status returning amount_total=4900). Frontend: catch-all route redirects /REPLACE_WITH_PRO_DISCORD_INVITE and /some-random-garbage to landing with hero rendered (no black screen). /performance free signup shows fallback 'Discord invite link will be shared soon!' and page has ZERO anchors with 'REPLACE' in href. Landing / free signup shows 'Discord invite coming soon!' with welcome onboarding + referral banner and no REPLACE hrefs. Proof gallery renders 4 cards; the video card opens proof-lightbox with data-testid=proof-lightbox-video and a valid /api/proof/image/{id} src. Admin /admin PROOF GALLERY (4) shows video thumbnail as <video> element. Stripe pro checkout returned session_id and status endpoint returned 200 with amount_total=4900 (500 regression fully fixed).

issues: Video readyState remained 0 after 3s in headless test — src is valid and Content-Length matches (8592244 bytes), likely just headless autoplay/preload constraint. Not a functional bug; consider adding preload='metadata' on <video> element for faster metadata load in production.

critical_code_review_comments: Guard `!discordInvite.startsWith('REPLACE')` is correctly applied in both PerformancePage.js (SignupForm + SuccessPanel) and LandingPage.js Pricing section — good symmetry.
App.js catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace/>}>` is correct; consider a dedicated 404 page in future but replace-to-root is safe.
proof.py cleanly added video/mp4|webm to ALLOWED_TYPES and bumped MAX_FILE_BYTES to 11MB; still base64 in Mongo which works but is ~33% overhead — for future scale consider GridFS or object storage.

PerformancePage.js line 597: `setDiscordInvite(tier === 'elite' ? '' : '')` is a no-op — both branches empty string. Post-payment SuccessPanel therefore ALWAYS shows fallback text even if env invites were real. Not a black-screen bug (fixed correctly) but the paid Discord link will never actually render until this is wired to the env-provided invite from the backend status response.
Consider adding preload='metadata' on ProofGallery <video> tags so browsers can load metadata for the play overlay without full download.
seed_data_creation: None — 3 fresh signup emails used (blackscreen-test-*, blackscreen-land-*); TEST_ PNG upload/delete self-cleaned in pytest; 4 seeded proof items preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Black-screen bug fully fixed. Backend base url must be exported before running pytest (export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...). test_proof_gallery.py was updated so test_image_bytes_served explicitly picks an image-typed shot (video is now sorted first in list). Landing signup requires selecting `landing-tier-free` BEFORE clicking `landing-submit-btn`, otherwise default tier=pro triggers Stripe redirect. Post-signup section testid is `post-signup-section`. Video lightbox testid: `proof-lightbox-video`. See /app/backend/tests/test_black_screen_and_video.py for video + Stripe regression coverage.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: PerformancePage guard only checked FREE placeholder env, so paid users saw a REPLACE_WITH placeholder rendered as href — relative-URL navigation to /REPLACE_WITH_PRO_DISCORD_INVITE hit no route → blank screen. Fixes verified: (a) guard changed to `!discordInvite.startsWith('REPLACE')` uniformly covers all placeholder tokens, (b) `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace/>}>` catch-all prevents any future unknown route from producing a blank body. Reproduced pre-fix by navigating to /REPLACE_WITH_PRO_DISCORD_INVITE — post-fix now redirects to / with hero visible (body innerText length=2280).
